name: coding-rules-guard
description: Risk-routed workflow with strict minimal testing and current-session-main-model Plan and review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Current-session-main Plan, Luna Max WRITE, and review gates.
interface.longDescription: Coding Rules Guard routes low-risk work through a short FAST path, escalates cross-layer or high-risk work to FULL, and requires the current session's main model to create and review every write Plan. Each record names that model and its reasoning effort; it never falls back to fixed Sol/xhigh planning or review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose FAST or FULL, load only the current coding-rules phase, and use the current session main model as session_main for both Plan and final review, recording its actual model and reasoning effort at each gate. Do not fall back to fixed Sol/xhigh planning or review. Do not create reports, summaries, status documents, or test write-ups unless the user explicitly requests them.
